steps.text: Sit upright on a chair without leaning back.
Lift one knee towards your chest.
Lift it as high as is comfortable, without using your hands.
Lower it, then lift the other knee, at a steady pace.

safety: Use a sturdy chair without wheels.
Keep your feet flat on the floor between lifts.

mistakes.label: low_knee_lift
mistakes.wrong: your knees did not lift high enough
mistakes.right: Lift your knees a little higher, only as far as is comfortable.

mistakes.label: using_hands
mistakes.wrong: your hands pulled your leg up
mistakes.right: Lift your legs without pulling them up with your hands.
